Aurelia Skyways incident report: lost companion animal crate handling and escalation through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.  

During the overnight movement for a routine companion animal connection, our desk received an alert that a crate containing a service companion had not arrived at the destination as scheduled. A traveler reported that Louie, the pet in question, was expected to proceed on the same itinerary but remained unconfirmed for handoff. The initial review began with verification of the crate description against the travel file, followed by confirmation of the baggage and manifest tags associated with the shipment. We then cross-checked station logs for the departure segment and consulted the nearby station liaison to determine whether the crate was delayed, misrouted, or held pending inspection.

<<FACT F118>>  

After the scope of the delay was confirmed, we issued practical status guidance to the traveler, ensuring that the companion’s care plan remained protected while movement was being traced. The shift coordinator coordinated a calm, stepwise escalation with the passenger operations lead, requesting an interface check between handling areas and the relevant sorting systems. In parallel, the desk documented all communications, including the time the traveler notified us, the symptoms of the missing handoff as described, and the assurances provided by station staff. When the carrier-side trace indicated the crate was not on the expected route, we elevated the case to the claims workflow and asked for a controlled search to continue across transfer points.

For follow-up, we maintained regular updates with the traveler and the ground team, including a check-in once more after the next sorting cycle. We also ensured that Louie’s care documentation and any required travel clearances were ready to prevent rebooking complications. The desk concluded the shift with an active case reference, confirmed points of contact at each involved station, and prepared the traveler to receive the next status message promptly. The matter was treated with care, and the team remained focused on restoring safe custody.  

Companion Animal Travel Desk
